name: Fury
oracle_text:
Double strike
When this creature enters, it deals 4 damage divided as you choose among any number of target creatures and/or planeswalkers.
Evoke—Exile a red card from your hand.
blocked_sentences: When this creature enters, it deals 4 damage divided as you choose among any number of target creatures and/or planeswalkers.

needs.what: `damage` with `divided` inside a triggered ability's effects, with the division announced when the trigger is put on the stack and its targets chosen (603.3d / 601.2d), over an ability-level target spec of 'any number of target creatures and/or planeswalkers' capped at one target per point of damage
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `damage.divided` exists, but `loader._check_division_homes` refuses it anywhere but a top-level spell effect ('divided damage is only supported as a top-level effect of a spell'), because `Game._ask_damage_division` is only called from `Game._cast` and `engine.division.divided_damage` reads only `card.spell_effects`. `distribute_counters` is the activated-ability-only analogue and divides counters, not damage; splitting into fixed per-target `damage` effects would fix the target count and the split, an approximation
